title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend - Distributed Systems
description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production - safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, https://www.gpbullhound.com/articles/top-100-next-unicorns-the-uk-france-and-germany-lead-with-the-most-promising-technology-companies-in-europe/ 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ https://page.camunda.com/wp-2025-gartner-magic-quadrant-for-boat for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies https://flexa.careers/companies/camunda, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

As a Senior Software Engineer, Backend on Camunda’s Distributed Systems team, you’ll help build and evolve the durable, highly available, horizontally scalable streaming platform that underpins Camunda 8’s Orchestration Cluster and powers mission‑critical processes for customers around the world.

As part of the Distributed Systems team, you will work on technically challenging and rewarding projects, such as expanding on our multi-Raft implementation, our SWIM-based cluster membership algorithm, or high performance network and disk I/O pipelines.

At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, design, QA, and sales, and work with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence the evolution of our platform to meet our customer’s needs.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk https://www.camundacon.com/event-session/camundacon-amsterdam-2025/one-exporter-to-rule-them-all-exploring-camunda-exporter/?on_demand=true from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You Will Do:

- Design, build, and maintain backend services for the distributed streaming platform that powers the foundation for Camunda 8’s orchestration capabilities, ensuring durability, high availability, and horizontal scalability.

- Lead medium‑to‑large engineering initiatives (3+ months) end‑to‑end: partner with Product to translate business problems into technical requirements, write solution designs, draft and maintain project plans, and drive timely, high‑quality delivery.

- Help mature our disaster recovery and resilience story, including implementing and evolving an online backup/restore API and contributing to improved multi‑region and multi‑tenant capabilities for our cloud offering.

- Design and implement developer and operator tooling that makes it easier to understand, troubleshoot, and safely operate a complex distributed system in production environments.

- Improve engineering effectiveness by collaborating with DevOps and other Core Application teams on CI, testing, and local development workflows to reduce PR time‑to‑merge and the overhead of working on multiple features in parallel.

- Participate in L3 support and on‑call rotations, partnering closely with Support and SRE to investigate and resolve complex, performance‑sensitive production issues, and feeding what you learn back into our pr

title: Senior Payments Engineer — Acquiring & Payment Processing
description:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)
About Sezzle :
With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!
Compensation :
For this senior development role, with 7+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience.
About the Role:
We're hiring a Senior Payments Engineer to own and scale the systems at the heart of Sezzle 's acquiring and payment-processing stack - the services that integrate with processors and gateways (Stripe, Adyen, Fiserv, Plaid, and more partners from the broader acquiring ecosystem), move funds, and keep transactions accurate, auditable, and resilient.
This is a backend-focused, high-ownership role. You'll partner closely with Product, Risk, Compliance, and Support, as well as other engineering teams, to deliver scalable solutions to hard problems in authorization, settlement, reconciliation, and disputes. You'll mentor teammates, unblock peers, and occasionally lead small project teams to delivery.
What You'll Do:

• Design and build backend services in Golang that integrate with payment processors, gateways, and card networks

• Own critical money-movement flows end to end: authorization, capture, settlement, refunds, reconciliation, and chargeback/dispute handling

• Build idempotent, fault-tolerant, auditable transaction processing within a distributed architecture (transactional outbox patterns; queues such as Kafka, SQS, or RabbitMQ)

• Operate within PCI DSS scope - tokenization, network tokens, secure handling of payment data, and 3DS/SCA flows where applicable

• Instrument and monitor payment health: authorization/decline rates, processor performance, latency, and settlement accuracy, driving continuous improvement

• Use AI tooling (Claude and equivalent LLMs) as part of your daily workflow to accelerate design, coding, research, testing, and documentation - within Sezzle 's security and data-handling policies

• Mentor engineers and help raise the bar across the team

• Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.

What We Look For:

• 7+ years of backend or full-stack engineering experience, with meaningful time spent on payments, fintech, or money-movement systems

• Strong Go (preferred), or comparable experience in Python, building and serving REST APIs

• Hands-on experience integrating with payment processors, gateways, or acquiring systems, and familiarity with payments fundamentals: authorization vs. settlement, tokenization, idempotency, reconciliation, and chargebacks/disputes

• Experience in distributed, cloud-based architectures using patterns like transactional outboxes or queuing tools (Kafka, SQS, RabbitMQ)

• Demonstrated, hands-on use of Claude or an equivalent LLM to enhance productivity, research, and communication - you're comfortable making AI a core part of how

title: Senior Software Engineer, Engagement
description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord is about giving people the power to create space to find belonging in their lives. We want to make it easier for you to talk regularly with the people you care about. We want you to build genuine relationships with your friends and communities close to home or around the world. Original, reliable, playful, and relatable. These are the values that connect our users and our employees at Discord.

We're looking for a highly motivated, mission-focused Senior Engineer to join our Engagement team. Engagement is responsible for improving the core value of Discord, including chatting, hanging out with friends, and expressing yourself. We work on improving core features like messaging, voice chat, user profiles, and app navigation. You will work across the full stack to build delightful and impactful features that are focused on making Discord the best place to play games and hangout with your friends online.

We’re looking for engineers that have strong product sense and are fearless in jumping between technical stacks. You’ll be working with highly experienced engineering peers and cross functional partners.

What You'll Be Doing

• Building delightful products with a very high bar for quality, performance, and a focus on impact

• Working with Product, Design, Data Science, UX Research, and Marketing to shape the team’s vision and roadmap

• Helping find the right solutions that balance delight, speed of delivery, and impact by collaborating with design and product partners

You Will Thrive In This Role If

• You have 5+ years of experience as a Software Engineer

• You have specialized in building consumer-facing products on web and mobile platforms

• You have developed domain expertise in either web or mobile front-end (or both)

• You are eager to learn new languages and frameworks, and are comfortable working across the full stack when needed

• You have worked in a product team with clear metrics goals and had a measurable positive impact on customers

• You have a strong product sense and take pride in sweating the details of great UX

• You are motivated to help your team members succeed and grow and learn from each other through empathetic feedback

Bonus Points

• You are a Discord user, and understand the core features and flow of Discord communications

• You’ve worked on React Native products

 

The US base salary range for this full-time position is $196,000 to $245,000  + equity + benefits. Our salary ranges are determined by role and level. Within the range, individual pay is determined by additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Please note that the compensation details listed in US role postings reflect the base salary only, and do not include equity, or benefits.

Why Discord? 

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We're a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests, and helps developers build and grow their businesses. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process. We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know.

title: Communications & Marketing Manager, Japan
description:
ABOUT US

Sierra is the leading platform for customer-facing AI agents, working with many of the world's biggest brands - including The GAP, Rocket Mortgage, SoFi, Sutter Health, and SoftBank - to transform how they serve customers and grow their businesses. We are primarily an in-person company based in San Francisco, with growing offices across North America, Europe, and Asia.

We are guided by a set of values that are at the core of our actions and define our culture: Trust, Customer Obsession, Craftsmanship, Intensity, and a commitment to balancing Family along the way. These values are the foundation of our work, and we are committed to upholding them in everything we do.

Our co-founders are Bret Taylor https://www.linkedin.com/in/brettaylor/ and Clay Bavor https://www.linkedin.com/in/claybavor/. Bret currently serves as Board Chair of OpenAI. Previously, he was co-CEO of Salesforce (which had acquired the company he founded, Quip) and CTO of Facebook. Bret was also one of Google's earliest product managers and co-creator of Google Maps. Before founding Sierra, Clay spent 18 years at Google, where he most recently led Google Labs. Earlier, he started and led Google’s AR/VR effort, Project Starline, and Google Lens. Before that, Clay led the product and design teams for Google Workspace.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

- Set the standard for great marketing and PR in a hyper growth, founder-led company.

- Work cross functionally to raise awareness of Sierra.

- Maintain overall responsibility for local marketing as well as press, public speaking and social media.

- Be a key part of Sierra’s global Marcomms team - pitching in as needed.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

- Deep knowledge of Japan and the Japanese tech/business environment.

- Entrepreneurial and scrappy - you like to try new things, and you lean into risk.

- A problem solver - you roll up your sleeves and solve what’s thrown at you.

- Fast and calm - you move quickly and are poised under pressure.

- Strong execution - you deliver what you promise, to a high standard.

- Creative - you can set the standard for what drives conversation in enterprise PR.

- Excellent communicator - you have strong written and verbal communications.

- Great team player - you’re low ego and enjoy working with people at every level. You are good at building and maintaining relationships, internally and externally.

- Understanding of marketing, the press and social media - either from working at a company, in government or as a journalist.

- Good judgement and professionalism - you can navigate ambiguity and can be trusted with sensitive or confidential initiatives.

EVEN BETTER

- Proven track record working in a fast paced company.

- Strong written and spoken English and Japanese.

OUR VALUES

- Trust: We build trust with our customers with our accountability, empathy, quality, and responsiveness. We build trust in AI by making it more accessible, safe, and useful. We build trust with each other by showing up for each other professionally and personally, creating an environment that enables all of us to do our best work.

- Customer Obsession: We deeply understand our customers’ business goals and relentlessly focus on driving outcomes, not just technical milestones. Everyone at the company knows and spends time with our customers. When our customer is having an issue, we drop everything and fix it.

- Craftsmanship: We get the details right, from the words on the page to the system architecture. We have good taste. When we notice something isn’t right, we take the time to fix it. We are proud of the products we produce. We continuously self-reflect to continuously self-improve.

- Intensity: We know we don’t have the luxury of patience. We play to win. We care about our product being the best, and when it isn’t, we fix it. When we fail, we talk about it openly and without blame so we succeed the next time.

- Family: We know that balance and intensity are compatible, and we model it in our actions

title: Senior Software Engineer II - LLM Observability
description:
What We’re Building

Honeycomb is a service for the near and present future, defining observability and raising expectations of what developer tools can do! We’re working with well known companies like HelloFresh, Slack, LaunchDarkly, and Vanguard and more across a range of industries. This is an exciting time in our trajectory, we’ve closed Series D funding, scaled past the 200-person mark, and were named to Forbes’ America’s Best Startups of 2022 and 2023!

If you want to see what we’ve been up to, please check out these blog posts and Honeycomb .io press releases.

Who We Are

We come for the impact, and stay for the culture! We’re a talented, opinionated, passionate, fiercely inclusive, and responsible group of bees. We have conviction and we strive to live our values every day. We want our people to do what they truly love amongst a team of highly talented (but humble) peers.

How We Work

We are a fully distributed company, which means we believe it is not where you sit, but how you deliver that matters most. We invest in our people and care about how you orient to our culture and processes. At the same time we imbue a lot of trust, autonomy, and accountability from Day 1.

Little more about the team:
The LLM Observability (LLM O11y) team builds the foundational layer that makes AI workloads observable in Honeycomb . We define how AI systems are represented in telemetry (spans, traces, token usage, cost, eval signals, etc), and ensure that data from diverse ecosystems (e.g., LangChain, OpenLLMetry, Braintrust) is normalized into a consistent OpenTelemetry-based model.

This team owns the infrastructure and data model that all downstream AI observability experiences rely on. Our work powers everything from cost analysis to anomaly detection. If you’re excited about defining and building the “source of truth” for how AI systems behave in production, this is the team for you.
What you’ll do in the role:

•
Design, build, and deliver backend systems and APIs. You'll architect and implement APIs and backend services in Go, emphasizing clarity, maintainability, and backward compatibility. You'll think proactively about cost, scale, and risk - anticipating technical issues and exploring alternatives and tradeoffs thoroughly.

•
Build and maintain full-stack product features. You'll contribute frontend (React/TypeScript) and backend (Go) code to build robust product features, maintaining proficiency across the stack. You'll deliver impactful features that add value for our customers, our team, and Honeycomb overall.

•
Provide technical leadership. You'll define patterns and operational guidelines that raise the bar for the team and beyond. You'll plan, lead, and deliver complex, multi-team projects - including ones with external dependencies - ensuring alignment and mentoring teammates along the way. We rotate tech lead responsibilities with each feature to allow everyone on the team to use and grow these skills.

•
Collaborate across disciplines. You'll work closely within a product triad model alongside design and product partners, from discovery through delivery, iterating quickly based on user feedback. You'll contribute to the team's technical roadmap and help shape quarterly product roadmaps, tying technical considerations to business outcomes.

•
Support and own your software in production. You'll participate in on-call rotations to ensure reliable operations and proactively address user pain points. You know when to shift between forward-looking feature work and production needs.

•
Communicate clearly and multiply your impact. Regular written and verbal communication, collaboration, and feedback are foundational skills you'll use daily. You'll mentor engineers, share knowledge, and delegate to help others grow - your goal is to make everyone around you more effective.

title: Video Editor
description:
Employment Type: Full-Time
Schedule: 9:00AM - 6:00PM EST
Salary Range: $1,300 - $1,800 per month
Our client is a dynamic content creation studio specializing in high-quality podcasts, videos, educational content, and digital media. They produce everything from short-form social content to full-length YouTube shows and professional podcast distributions.
They are seeking a skilled and versatile Video Editor who can excel in editing educational videos, event highlight reels, interview content, short-form social clips, and long-form podcast/YouTube episodes. This role is ideal for someone who works fast, communicates clearly, and understands modern content formats across all platforms.
Role Overview
The ideal candidate is highly organized, proactive, and efficient under tight deadlines. You must have a strong understanding of current social media trends, pacing for educational content, and long-form storytelling for YouTube and podcasts.
Key Responsibilities
1. Educational Video Editing (Primary Focus)

• Edit short educational videos using raw footage, talking-head content, screen recordings, or multi-camera setups.

• Select the best takes and build clear, engaging narratives.

• Sync high-quality audio with video.

• Add supporting visuals (graphics, lower thirds, on-screen text, B-roll).

• Apply sound effects, licensed music, color correction, and polished finishing touches.

• Add accurate captions for accessibility and sound-off viewing.

2. Short-Form Content Creation (Social Media Clips)

• Review long-form content (YouTube videos, interviews, podcasts) to identify compelling moments.

• Edit short-form clips (15-60 seconds) for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, etc.

• Add dynamic captions, text treatments, motion elements, zooms/punch-ins, graphics, and sound design.

• Optimize pacing and hooks for maximum retention and virality.

3. Event Highlight Reels & Interview Content

• Edit high-energy event recaps using professional footage, transitions, text overlays, and music.

• Craft clean, polished interview-based videos with strong narrative flow.

• Incorporate B-roll, branded graphics, and color correction to maintain a consistent visual identity.

4. Long-Form Editing (Podcasts & YouTube)

• Edit full podcast episodes and long-form YouTube videos.

• Assemble multi-camera timelines, add graphics, incorporate B-roll, and create smooth pacing.

• Ensure brand consistency, storytelling clarity, and a clean, polished final output.

5. Audio Editing & Production

• Clean, level, and master audio tracks for podcast release (Apple Podcasts, Spotify, etc.).

• Handle noise reduction, EQ, compression, and clarity enhancement.

• Export final podcast audio in the required platforms’ technical specs.

6. Workflow & Communication

• Manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet quick-turn deadlines.

• Deliver consistent updates, follow organized naming conventions, and maintain efficient file management.

• Communicate proactively about needs, blockers, and delivery timelines.

Requirements

• Proven video editing experience, specifically in:

• Educational videos

• Short-form social content

• Event highlight reels

• Interviews

• Long-form podcast or YouTube content

• Expert-level proficiency in at least two of the following editing software's:

• Adobe Premiere Pro

• Final Cut Pro

• CapCut

• Strong understanding of:

• Social trends and viral content structure

• Video codecs, formats, and aspect ratios

• Color correction and basic motion graphics

• Audio editing and mixing

• Fast, reliable, and detail-oriented, with the ability to meet tight deadlines.

• Creative instincts and an eye for storytelling, pacing, and audience engagement.

• Additionally, we're looking for someone who's experienced in:

• Editing 10-bit footage

• Creating realistic AI characters of real people,

• Editing Talking head content

• Editing Event highlight reels

• Editing Real estate video content

Benefits

title: Nurse Practitioner
description:
G’day, we’re Mosh & Moshy.
Our mission is to get Aussies the best possible health outcomes through best-in-class health programs.
We know the current healthcare system isn’t meeting the needs of the modern Australian, and we reckon there’s a better, more holistic way. Our programs across hair loss, sexual health, skincare, mental health and weight management are easy, accessible and completely discreet.
More than a job
There’s nothing better than knowing the work you’re doing matters and makes a genuine difference. We’re pretty lucky that, at Mosh & Moshy, this is the norm rather than the exception.
We’re looking for two endorsed Nurse Practitioners to join our multidisciplinary clinical team and provide high-quality, evidence-based care at an advanced nursing level. Working remotely, you’ll help improve patients’ access to healthcare and support them throughout their treatment journey.
Reporting to our Clinical Operations Manager, you’ll combine strong clinical judgement with clear, compassionate communication to deliver a seamless telehealth experience.
What you’ll do

• Consult with new and existing patients via telephone and video, providing education, clinical advice and support

• Strong clinical judgement and a commitment to safe, evidence-based, patient-centred care

• Confident, clear and empathetic communication skills, particularly in telephone and video consultations

• The ability to work effectively and collaboratively within a multidisciplinary clinical environment

• Confidence navigating digital clinical platforms, documentation systems and telehealth tools

• A proactive approach to identifying opportunities to improve patient care, systems and processes

What’s on offer
We hire people who share our values, believe in our mission and are passionate about the future of healthcare. Some of the reasons our team loves Mosh & Moshy include:

• A fully remote role with the flexibility to work from home, within Australia

• Meaningful work that makes a real, positive difference in patients’ lives

• Plenty of opportunity to learn and grow as the company evolves

• Access to up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave

• Two additional paid company closure days each year

• Two days of purpose leave for mental health or learning and development

• Access to on-demand learning through Go1

• EAP support and online wellbeing programs

• ClassPass credit discounts

• Discounts across a range of Mosh & Moshy products and services

• A creative, friendly and collaborative team

Better, together
Everyone is different, and we think that’s what makes life interesting. We believe our differences generate better ideas, bring valuable perspectives and help us represent the people we care for.

The Cybersecurity Analyst is a hands-on operational role within the Cyber Operations team, responsible for frontline security monitoring, incident response support, exposure management validation, and compliance evidence. Working under the direction of the Director, Cyber Operations and senior engineers, the Analyst is the execution layer of KLDiscovery 's security program monitoring what matters, responding when it counts, and keeping the team's operational processes running reliably. Security Monitoring & Alert Triage

• Serve as first-line eyes on the environment validating and escalating CrowdStrike MDR-confirmed findings, reviewing MDR outputs, assessing context, and ensuring accurate internal escalation to the Engineers and Director

• Monitor security alerts from tools operating outside MDR scope
Triage alerts for AI tool misuse, anomalous AI-related activity, and other emerging threat patterns as directed by the Security Manager

• Flag SIEM and identity health monitoring gaps, anomalies, and coverage issues to the engineering team - you are the first to notice when something looks wrong or missing

Incident Response Support

• Maintain accurate and current exposure tracking records so the engineering team always has clean data for prioritization decisions and compliance reporting

Compliance & Audit Support

• Assist the GRC team with technical control evidence, gap tracking, and remediation documentation

• Maintain documentation that supports annual security compliance attestations relevant to assigned business units

title: Customer Success Lead - UK/I
description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

- ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

- ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

- ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

HOW WE WORK

- High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

- Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

- AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company-from engineering to growth to operations.

- Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

- Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

- Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

- Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

- Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

- Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

- Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the Role

As the Customer Success Lead you'll lead a team of experienced Customer Success team members across the UK&I region. You'll balance people leadership, strategic direction, and hands-on customer impact - driving excellence in post-sales outcomes and ensuring your team consistently delivers measurable value to customers and the business.

You will:

- Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing CS team, owning team and regional NRR performance, customer retention, and expansion goals.

- Lead by example in complex post-sales and renewal cycles, unblocking issues, driving adoption, and identifying expansion opportunities.

- Set strategic direction for the team, aligning customer success initiatives with company goals and market trends.

- Monitor and optimize delivery quality across all accounts, ensuring consistency, excellence, and predictability in customer outcomes, implementing scalable processes that improve accuracy, visibility, and operational efficiency.

- Design and implement repeatable playbooks for renewals, upsells, and adoption; automate workflows and tools to scale team impact.

- Own the ongoing development and optimization of best practices for Commercial and Scale playbooks,

title: Team Lead, Android Core Product - Helsinki, Finland
description:
Remote
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.
Over 50 million people use Speechify 's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading - PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites - into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify 's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its Design award winner for inclusivity for 2025.
Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting - Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.
Overview
Our Android app is the most used text-to-speech app in the Play Store, and the user base has grown faster than the way we build for it. We're looking for a Team Lead to own core product work and to raise how the team works around it.
This is a hands-on role, and we want to be clear about the split. You'll be writing code, reviewing code, and owning features of your own - that doesn't shrink when you take this job. The rest of it is the part that doesn't happen on its own: catching when three people have solved the same problem separately, deciding which version everyone should use, and making sure the team's time goes to the work that actually needs a decision. If you want to stop building, this isn't the role. If you want the code you write to be the smaller half of your impact, it is.
We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount.
What You'll Do

• Own major features end to end, working closely with our design team - from the decision through to release. This is real delivery, not oversight

• Own, maintain, and improve reliability metrics for key features

• Review pull requests and give the kind of feedback people learn from, not just approval

• Unblock the team: notice when someone has been stuck on the same thing for two days, and go take a look yourself

• Notice when something one person built should become the version the team uses, and see that change through

• Keep the shared pieces in working order - tested, clear enough for someone else to pick up, and consolidated when three versions of the same thing appear

• Call it when the team is ready to change how it works, rather than waiting for that to happen on its own

• Reduce how much manual intervention it takes to get a correct release out

• When the same problem shows up twice, get the underlying setup changed so there isn't a third time

• Shift verification left: grow what can be checked automatically so the nightly build going to QA is a confirmation rather than the first time anyone finds out

• Run planning so the team's attention goes to the work that still needs decisions rather than the work that's already clear

• Work out how much review each area needs, and where a person always signs off regardless

• Participate in discussions across Product, Design, and Engineering, and bring the team's constraints into those rooms early

• Handle critical issues, own feature releases, and provide nightly builds for the QA team

• Make sure the people early in their careers are getting work they can learn from, and the time to learn from it

Some of your engineers will be skeptical about parts of how the team is asked to work. In our experience that skepticism tends to be specific and worth acting on, and the people raising it are often the right ones to hand the underlying problem to.
An Ideal Candidate Should Have

• 5+ years of software engineering experien

title: Customer Experience Improvement Manager

About the role

We are seeking a Customer Experience Improvement Manager (CX Improvement Manager) to lead the end-to-end implementation and optimisation of high-impact customer experience initiatives. This newly created role will build upon our existing quality audit and failure demand analysis and translate them into proactive, systemic initiatives that address root causes and prevent recurring customer friction.

The (CX Improvement Manager) will identify the root causes of both reasons that drive users to seek help (i.e. contact our Customer Service teams) and also reasons for customer dissatisfaction (DSAT). Using these insights the role holder will partner cross-functionally with CS, Quality, Operations, Product and Tech teams to project-manage operational solutions - such as proactive incident communications, automated surge protocols, improvements to our AI Virtual Assistant and social media engagement playbooks.

If you are a data-driven operations specialist who thrives on solving systemic friction, building scalable workflows, and directly moving CX metrics, this role is for you.

What you'll be doing

• Strategic Program & Project Management

Execute High-Impact CX Initiatives: Project-manage core quality programs

30-60-90 Day Impact Roadmaps: Design and execute structured roadmaps focused on addressing top customer contact and DSAT drivers (e.g. bet settlement queries, policy related concerns and deposit/withdrawal challenges).

Maintain, triage and manage (i.e. verify, categorise, prioritise) the operational backlog of bugs, intent gaps, and UX improvements for the AI Virtual Assistant, serving as the bridge between frontline CS teams and Product to drive continuous bot performance.

• Cross-Functional Collaboration & Product Alignment

Product & Tech Integration: Partner with CS, Product, Ops and Tech teams to implement initiatives like dynamic, event-driven in-app alerts and automated IVR messaging to deflect/intercept inbound ticket surges before they reach live agents.

CSAT & DSAT Management: Own overall CSAT/DSAT performance, linking root causes for dissatisfaction to improvement initiatives and measuring the direct benefit of changes made.

Social Media & ORM Optimization: Revamp Online Reputation Management (ORM) playbooks for X (Twitter), Telegram and Facebook, transitioning teams from highly manual and robotic responses to more automated and efficient ways of working whilst retaining a context-aware engagement approach.

What you'll bring

• Experience: 5+ years in Customer Operations, Quality Management or CX Project Management, preferably in high-volume environments (Fintech, iGaming, E-commerce or Tech)

• Project Management Skills: Proven track record of managing cross-functional initiatives across Product, Tech, and Customer Operations using methodologies like Agile or Lean.

• Prior experience operating in high-volatility, real-time event industries (e.g., sports betting, live payments, or trading platforms).

• Certified 6 Sigma Green or Blackbelt

title: Head of Marketing, EMEA

ABOUT EXA

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders & dropouts alike.

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

We are looking for a Head of Marketing, EMEA based in London to lead Exa's marketing across Europe.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

This is Exa's first senior marketing leader outside the United States. You will set the marketing strategy for Europe and run it as a commercial function, tied to the region's pipeline number. EMEA is many markets with different buyers, languages, and routes to market. Deciding which ones matter first, and how Exa wins in each, is the core of the job.

Sales coverage is coming online across the UK and EU. You will be the marketing counterpart: deciding where to invest, which motions to run in which markets, and how a fast-moving American AI infrastructure company earns credibility with buyers in London, Berlin, Zurich, and Amsterdam.

This is a player-coach role. You will write the regional plan and then help execute it yourself, from shaping a campaign and adapting the message to hosting an executive dinner and sitting in pipeline reviews with Sales. You start as a team of one, with meaningful budget for field events, conferences, and developer events. We expect your first hire, an early-career field events marketer, to join within months, with more headcount as growth justifies.

Exa's buyers are technical, and much of our growth starts with developers who sign up and build before anyone talks to Sales. The right person understands both product-led growth with developers and account-based programs for enterprise buyers. You will work closely with Sales, Product, and Marketing to keep all of it pointed at the same priorities.

This is an AI-first role at an AI-first company. Account research, localization, campaign analysis, and reporting should be workflows you build, since one person covering a dozen markets only works if the work is automated.

This role is based in-person in London, with regular travel across EMEA and periodic trips to our San Francisco HQ.

 

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 

EMEA MARKETING STRATEGY

Own the regional marketing plan. Translate Exa's global priorities into a plan for EMEA, prioritize markets by opportunity and sales coverage, and decide where to invest across markets and programs. Own the EMEA marketing budget, which centers on field events, conferences, developer events, and selective local sponsorships (including developer creators and communities). Success is measured by revenue growth.

 

GO-TO-MARKET BY MARKET

Build a go-to-market approach for priority markets across the UK, EU, Middle East and Africa. The right motion differs by market (direct, partner-led, or channel-based), and some markets should wait until product-led signal justifies the spend.

Anduril Industries

The user base supported by this role includes supply chain analysts, procurement specialists, buyers, planners, and program managers. Beyond reactive support, you will be embedded in supply chain operations, working cross-functionally with Procurement, Purchasing, Planning, Program Management, IT, Engineering, Business Systems, and other stakeholders to solve complex systems problems that span multiple teams and don't fall neatly into any single domain. You bring structure to ambiguity, think in systems, and drive solutions where others see only complexity.

• Conduct root cause analysis by observing actual supply chain processes and how they interact with digital systems to identify disconnects between software functionality and operational needs.

• Escalate to engineering support when required and provide clear operational context to software development teams about supply chain realities and downstream impacts.

• Develop workarounds and best practices that accommodate both system limitations and supply chain requirements, minimizing disruption to ongoing operations.

• Proactively identify potential unreported problems by regularly analyzing system data patterns, monitoring supply chain KPIs, and reviewing process adherence across platforms.

Cross-Functional Problem Solving & Systems Thinking

• Step into high-priority problems that span multiple teams and systems, bringing structure to ambiguity and driving resolution without waiting for clear ownership or prescribed solutions.

We design, test, and deploy secure, AI-ready systems that move agencies from pilots to production without breaking governance, compliance, or mission continuity. Our Mission Studio model creates shared environments where policy, data, security, and operations come together. We are capability-driven and competitive by design, not program-dependent. Our leadership has operated inside the federal systems we now transform, bringing institutional knowledge that accelerates delivery and reduces risk. If real delivery motivates you more than slides, and you want your work to compound across programs and agencies, Imagineeer is growing and we are building the team to match.

About the role

Imagineeer is seeking an experienced Oracle DBA/Developer to join our team supporting the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) Human Resources Information Technology (HRIT) contract. In this role, you will help modernize how HHS receives, processes, and uses critical HR and payroll data by consolidating and standardizing key federal data file exchanges, building reliable Oracle-based intake and processing workflows, and analyzing a large enterprise HR data environment to document how its tables, reports, and downstream data exchanges are used across the Department. This is a hands-on technical role for someone who enjoys bringing structure and clarity to complex data systems and who can work effectively with both technical teams and government stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities:

• Support consolidation of CIDB files, including obtaining the CIDB Full file from Office of Personnel Management (OPM) and generating the CIDB Abbreviated file internally to eliminate reliance on externally supplied abbreviated extracts.

• Standardize the intake, format, and processing of the Admin (SAC Codes) file received from OPM.

• Standardize the intake, format, and processing of the Paytran file, including developing a file format specification to share with OPM and establishing receipt of the file from OPM

• Analyze the technical usage of the Enterprise Human Capital Management (EHCM) data dump, including reviewing 100+ data tables to determine purpose and usage, identifying derived files, associated reports, and data exchanges with HHS Operating Divisions (OPDIVs) that rely on the data dump.

• Design, develop, and maintain PL/SQL packages, procedures, and ETL processes to ingest, validate, and transform incoming data files.

• Perform Oracle database administration tasks, including performance tuning, schema management, backup and recovery, and security configuration.

• Produce technical documentation, including data dictionaries, data lineage, file format specifications, and standard operating procedures.

Qualifications and Skills:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Information Technology, or a related field.

• 6+ years of experience as an Oracle DBA and/or Oracle Developer

• Advanced proficiency in SQL and PL/SQL, including stored procedures, complex queries, and performance tuning

• Experience building ETL processes for flat-file ingestion (fixed-width and delimited) using SQL*Loader, external tables, or equivalent tools

• Experience developing file format specifications or interface control documents for external data exchanges

• Experience standardizing and consolidating data file processes

• Experience working with OPM file exchanges

• Ability to analyze large, complex data sets to determine purpose, usage, and downstream dependencies

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

Desired Skills and Competencies:

• Familiarity with Oracle HCM / EHCM data structures

• Experience with federal HR and payroll data, such as EHRI, personnel and payroll transaction data, or the OPM Guide to Data Standards

title: Software Engineer, Internship - Query Engines
description:
A World-Changing Company
 
Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

The Role
We are a software engineering team applying open-source data technologies to some of the world's hardest and most important problems. We build the data processing infrastructure that underpins Palantir Foundry, supporting applications that help hospitals care for more patients, help clinical teams coordinate timely diagnoses, and keep essential supplies moving through global disruption.
 
You will work deep inside the systems that make this possible: how computations are represented, how query plans are optimised, how operators execute, and how data is read and written efficiently. We build on and extend Apache Spark, Apache DataFusion, and Apache Iceberg, bringing advances in open-source engines and table formats into the demanding environments our customers operate in. Our work serves many products and workloads across Foundry, including no-code pipelines, interactive analysis, and the processing that keeps the Ontology up to date.
 
Working alongside experienced engineers, you will take on real problems in our production systems. That could mean writing a new planning rule, adding a capability to a native execution engine, or making large tables faster to scan. description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

TEAM AND ROLE

- Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant - Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

- Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in industry - Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

- Build real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world - Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

- You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

- You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

- Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

- Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

YOUR IMPACT

As Lead R&D Engineer for the Stellaris tritium-breeding blanket, you will build and lead Proxima Fusion’s blanket development from initial concept to first prototype tests. You will translate a defined R&D budget into a small set of parallel breeder-blanket concepts, developed rapidly with external research and industrial partners.

Remote maintainability is a fundamental part of the blanket architecture from day one. Each concept must be thought with the power plant architecture in mind and demonstrate how blanket modules can be installed, connected, inspected, replaced and recovered remotely.

The objective is to leverage existing public research, challenge the most consequential assumptions, learn from hardware quickly and iterate to a functional blanket concept for our future commercial plant fleet.

- Own the rapid fail-fast prototype: select what to test and lead its design, procurement, manufacture, instrumentation, commissioning and test campaign on ambitious timelines.

- Own the translation of test results into updated models, requirements, risk assessments and design decisions.

- Own and build the multidisciplinary, technical design team.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our MEGA Team

Multi-Embodiment Generalist Agent (MEGA) team within Wayve Labs as a founding member.

MEGA is building foundation models for general-purpose robots beyond self-driving vehicles. Our focus is on creating intelligent agents that can perceive, reason, move and manipulate the physical world across diverse embodiments, including mobile manipulators, dual-arm platforms and humanoids.

🧠 Your day-to-day

The system will draw on localization and mapping, state estimation, and sensor fusion to produce offline 3D geometric reconstructions and best-estimate ego motion from heterogeneous vehicle platforms and sensor suites. The work will support internal validation, data enrichment, and model development by turning raw sensor data into reliable, quality-assessed 3D ground-truth outputs.

The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

Full-Time, Exempt

EDUCATION

Rho’s data has two types of consumers: people and AI agents. As our data analyst, you will empower both with reliable data and meaningful insights. You’re accountable for faster and data-driven decision-making, not for the number of dashboards or reports built. This is a cross-functional role that will interface with data engineering as well as business-side stakeholders from GTM, Product, and other departments. - Prior experience in building or maintaining dashboards in Looker, Omni, Hex, Tableau, and other business intelligence or analytical tools

Nice to Have

- Experience working in financial services, banking, technology or a fast-paced startup

- Experience supporting multiple verticals or departments simultaneously

- Experience building out a dbt semantic layer and refining the warehouse as a surface area for both humans and AI agents

- Familiarity with machine learning concepts and predictive analytics

Due to our rapid growth and the sensitivity of our proprietary materials discovery platform, we are seeking a Security Engineer to ensure our innovation happens at speed without compromising the safety of our IP or our users.

YOUR IMPACT

In this role you will be building the automated security pipelines and AI-specific guardrails that protect our frontier models and research data, which is critical for maintaining the integrity of our materials discovery engine and the trust of our global partners.

 

As an early security hire, you won't be a manual blocker; instead, you will architect a "shift-left" culture where security is a fundamental product feature. - Manage secrets and vulnerability patching for containerized environments (e.g. Docker, Kubernetes) to ensure our research environment is resilient.

Interdisciplinary Collaboration & Security Culture

- Empower the engineering team to own security by providing tools for local IDE security scanning and pre-commit hooks.

- Act as a security educator, cultivating a culture of shared responsibility across the AI, chemistry, and engineering teams.

- Partner with researchers, chemists, and engineers to translate security requirements into practical workflows that support rather than slow down scientific work.

MUST HAVE SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

- You are motivated by the mission of using AI for planetary-scale impact and understand the high stakes of securing "deep tech" intellectual property.

- 3+ years of experience in a DevSecOps, Cloud Security, or Site Reliability Engineering role, preferably within a fast-paced startup or AI-centric company.

- Proven experience building and securing CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins).

title: Designer
description:
About the team

OpenAI didn’t begin as a traditional company. It began as an idea: that artificial intelligence could be developed in a way that benefits everyone. As a creative team, our role is to help make sure the work behind that idea is understood, as it leaves the lab and meets the world.

This company works at the frontier of intelligence. Like any frontier, it’s unfinished, constantly shifting, and still being explored. Our job is to stay close to that uncertainty and help shape how this story gets told, in a way that feels grounded and human. We do this through campaigns, launches, films, brand systems, and work that doesn’t fit neatly into any of those categories yet. This team is for people who want to help shape something from the beginning.

About the role

We’re looking for a Designer to create thoughtful, high-quality work across consumer campaigns and brand identity. You’ll contribute original ideas and turn creative direction into finished design across campaigns, digital experiences, social content, presentations, and brand materials.

- A portfolio showing strong visual ideas and execution across brand identity, campaigns, or related graphic design work.

- A solid command of typography, layout, composition, image-making, and visual hierarchy, with close attention to production detail.

- The ability to contribute to concept development and independently execute defined deliverables in collaboration with a creative lead.

- Proficiency in Figma, Adobe Creative Suite, or equivalent tools, with experience preparing files for collaborative design and production workflows.

- Practical curiosity about AI-assisted creative workflows and the ability to assess generated work critically rather than accept it as finished design.

- Clear communication, openness to critique, and the ability to manage multiple assignments as priorities and creative directions evolve.

- Experience with consumer or technology brands, motion, illustration, or creative coding is helpful. We value a portfolio that makes your own contribution and design process clear.

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. The Role
Unit4 serves a global community of professional services organizations - management consultancies, engineering and architectural practices, IT services firms, audit and advisory, and legal services. These businesses run on people: utilization, engagement profitability, and project delivery define how they win or lose. As Product Director for Professional Services, you own the vertical product vision, strategy, and roadmap that makes Unit4 the ERP of choice for mid-market PSOs.
This is not a generalist PM role with an industry overlay. You will have dedicated engineering capacity to build genuine vertical depth in the platform - industry-specific capabilities that horizontal product teams cannot and will not build. You will work in close partnership with horizontal PMs across Financials, HR, Projects, and Procurement to ensure the full platform delivers for PSOs end-to-end. You own the backlog, the outcomes, the roadmap, and the commercial case for why your vertical wins.
AI is actively reshaping how professional services firms operate. The automation of billable work, the compression of traditional T&M models, and the shift toward outcome- and subscription-based pricing are rewriting the economics of the sector. The right candidate understands where these firms are in that journey and what it means for the software they need. You have built enterprise software for PSOs, you know what the best solutions in this space do well and where they fall short, and you can translate an industry in transition into a product roadmap that stays ahead of it.
What You'll Do

• Own the Professional Services product vision, strategy, and multi-horizon roadmap; align it with Unit4 's platform strategy and commercial growth targets.

• Own feature outcomes, not just delivery - define clear adoption, usage, and customer impact goals for every capability you champion, and track performance against them after launch.

• Serve as the internal authority on the Professional Services vertical, providing product, marketing, analyst relations, and pre-sales teams with the industry grounding they need to position, demonstrate, and sell effectively.

• Lead a prioritized product backlog with dedicated engineering capacity - defining outcomes, success metrics, release plans, and quality criteria.

• Translate deep PSO market knowledge into specific, investment-backed product requirements: opportunity sizing, problem statements, and build-vs-partner decisions.

• Define industry-specific solution blueprints, reference configurations, and pre-built templates that accelerate customer time-to-value.

• Act as the vertical voice in planning conversations with horizontal product teams, ensuring PSO requirements are reflected in platform investment.

• Partner with the Industry Growth Director on launch readiness, pricing, packaging, and field enablement for new capabilities.

• Engage directly with strategic customers and the PS Industry Board to validate roadmap direction, co-innovate, and generate outcome evidence.

• Monitor the competitive landscape - know what NetSuite, Workday, Deltek, Kantata, and others are shipping and what it means for Unit4 's positioning.

• Work with partners to extend the value proposition for PSO customers.

What You'll Bring

• Proven product management experience building enterprise software - ERP, PSA, or enterprise SaaS - for professional services organizations. You have shipped products used by PSOs, not just advised on them.

• Deep operational knowledge of how PSOs run: pipeline-to-resource-to-revenue, utilization and leverage economics, engagement profitability, billing models, and partner/shareholder economics.
